title: Nobel Prize 2026: The Telescope Made of Antarctic Ice
description:
The 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics went to Francis Halzen for IceCube, a detector built from a cubic kilometre of South Pole ice.
It catches ghostly neutrinos from deep space and traced one to a black hole jet 3.7 billion light-years away.
